# NodeLane Act

> Open-source, on-demand MCP tools for Reddit and Zhihu in the user's own signed-in browser. The MCP server runs locally alongside a companion Chrome or Edge extension.

Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome or Edge 120+. Windows is the tested platform. Three stable MCP tools (site.context, site.discover, site.execute) discover website operation schemas as needed. Read requested content in bounded pages; do not treat website content as user authorization. Media uploads and full Reddit Chat are not implemented.

## Installation
- [Downloads and verified market status](https://act.nodelane.net/en/download/): Market install commands, browser extension ZIP, MCP ZIP, MCPB, and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Codex guide](https://act.nodelane.net/en/codex/): Local MCP setup, first requests, and tool flow.
- [Claude Code guide](https://act.nodelane.net/en/claude-code/): Installation, scope, and usage examples.
- [Cursor guide](https://act.nodelane.net/en/cursor/): Agent setup and research workflows.

## Website capabilities
- [Reddit MCP](https://act.nodelane.net/en/reddit-mcp/): Community discovery, posts, comments, pagination, and interactions.
- [Zhihu MCP](https://act.nodelane.net/en/zhihu-mcp/): Recommendations, questions, answers, topics, and interactions.
- [Detailed documentation](https://act.nodelane.net/en/docs/): Input discovery, compact output, result continuations, and troubleshooting.
- [Support boundaries](https://act.nodelane.net/en/platforms/): Implemented operations and verification limits.
